children: India has lowered windfall taxes on exports of petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel with immediate effect, according to a government order issued late on Wednesday.
Here are  more details from the order
The duty on diesel exports has been cut to 20 rupees per litre from 25 rupees earlier.
The levy on export of petrol been cut to 0.5 rupees per litre from 1.5 rupees earlier.
The tax on aviation turbine fuel has been set at 15 rupees per litre from 19 rupees earlier.
